player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Slitherlink on a {R}x{C} grid!
Draw a single continuous loop so each numbered cell has that many bordering edges.
Toggle edges with:
  [h r c] - toggle horizontal edge above dots at row r, column c
  [v r c] - toggle vertical edge left of dots at row r, column c
Numbers show required edge count, '.' means no constraint.
You have up to {max_turns} moves to solve the puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsela ya aksi e lebega e sa tlwaelesegile. Dirisanye [h row col] kgotsa [v row col].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Go nna kwa ntle ga boto.

outcome.win: O dirile sekgopi se le sengwe! Tharabololo ya thamalakane e rarabolotswe!
outcome.turn_limit: Go fitlhetswe selekanyo se o ka kgonang go tsamaya mo go sone.
